title: Eglon
summary: Raleigh names Eglon in the History of the World (1617).
description: Named in Raleigh's History of the World (1617). Eglon King of Moab, who commanded Israel eighteene yeeres, and whom Ehud slew. No yeere of the World was taken for him. Display only. No tier 1–4 chronology dates this person, so there is no sort year.

sorting_basis.note: No tier gives a birth year. Raleigh is display-only.

reign.date: mastered Israel and commanded them eighteene yeeres
reign.citation: Raleigh, The History of the World (1617, EEBO-TCP A10357), Book II, Part I, Chapter X, §. IV, subsection V, sig. 246b–247a
reign.note: Body intake. His 18 yeeres over Israel. Not a yeere of the World. year_am stays null. This does not change the sort.
